scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "host,dashboard,chat,analytics" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" "npm run dev -w apps/host" "npm run dev -w apps/mf-dashboard" "npm run dev -w apps/mf-chat" "npm run dev -w apps/mf-analytics"
scripts.serve:dist: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "host,dashboard,chat,analytics" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue" "npx http-server apps/host/dist -p 5000 --cors -c-1 --proxy http://localhost:5000?" "npx http-server apps/mf-dashboard/dist -p 5001 --cors -c-1" "npx http-server apps/mf-chat/dist -p 5002 --cors -c-1" "npx http-server apps/mf-analytics/dist -p 5003 --cors -c-1"
